name: Schwimmbad Restaurant
kurzbeschreibung:
**Swimming Pool Restaurant in Tirol** --- **

Enjoy a Refreshing Break in the Heart of Tirol

** After a refreshing dip in our **Schwimmbad**, indulge in a delicious meal at our **Restaurant** with a view of the sparkling water. Whether you crave hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, crispy **Kaiserschmarrn**, or a perfectly grilled **Tiroler Specknockel**, our menu offers a taste of authentic **Tiroler** flavors. **

Relax & Dine by the Pool

** Sunbathe, swim, and then unwind with a cold **Radler** or a steaming cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse-Suppe** while soaking up the mountain air. Our terrace invites you to linger—whether with friends, family, or just yourself. **

Perfect for Families & Groups

** With plenty of space for kids to splash around and adults to relax, our **Schwimmbad Restaurant** is the ideal spot for a fun-filled day. Try our **Apfelstrudel** for dessert or enjoy a hearty **Kaspressknödel**—pure **Tiroler** comfort food! **

Location & Opening Hours

** Find us in the heart of **Tirol**, just a short stroll from **Innsbruck**’s vibrant city center. Open daily from **10:00 AM** to **9:00 PM**—come by for a swim and a meal you won’t forget! **

Book Your Table Today

** Reservations welcome—whether for a romantic lunch by the pool or a family feast. Experience **Tirol**’s best **Schwimmbad Restaurant** and make your day unforgettable!
